ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.4). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab laid out like the vanilla Work tab: one row per free colonist, a fixed pawn name column and a horizontal lane of compact two-line WorkType cards, with one shared horizontal scroll and one outer vertical scroll. Each card shows the WorkType name (ellipsized, full name in tooltip) and the best relevant skill level plus a temporary passion marker. Incapable WorkTypes are filtered out of the lane, the default order and the stored/written order; the + picker still lists every remaining WorkType with its skill level and shows incapable ones greyed out as Incapaz (not selectable). The colony initializes once at game start: an existing colony copies its current vanilla Work-tab priorities without writing, while a new/default colony gets a scored skill recommendation (Patient, PatientBedRest and Firefighter pinned first) applied once. Later new and resurrected colonists are re-applied automatically. A Harmony hook captures genuine vanilla Work-tab edits, ignoring our own writes and the post-spawn settling window; a 120-tick suppression and EnableAndInitialize guard prevent a partial vanilla state from overwriting a stored order. The first edit writes dense rank 1..N straight into each pawn's Pawn_WorkSettings priorities and calls Notify_UseWorkPrioritiesChanged. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
